title.narrative: Strengthening Democracy and Respect for Fundamental Human Rights of Prisoners in Liberia

description.narrative: Enhance access and equity before the law for most vulnerable groups while supporting improved conditions of the correctional system. This action is based on four main areas of engagement: capacity building, delivery of services, awareness and advocacy/policy work.The focus will be on 4 correctional institutes of 3 counties (Margibi, Nimba and Bong )
